content.introduction: For the 12-month percentage change in the Consumer Price Index for selected categories as of August 2026, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reports: All items at 3.4%, Food at 2.7%, Food at home at 2.2%, Meats, poultry, fish, and eggs at 1.1%, Dairy and related products at -0.3%, Fruits and vegetables at 3.2%, Nonalcoholic beverages and beverage materials at 3.7%, Food away from home at 3.4%, Full service meals and snacks at 3.5%, Limited service meals and snacks at 3.2%, and Energy at 16.3%. The other sources do not provide updated figures beyond this.
